correctness.rationale: Leaf selection gives exact transitions ΔK=1-I, ΔS=d+2, ΔQ=2(d+1)-2Id. Conditioning on current tree gives four explicit recurrences. Starting from the deterministic three-leaf shape yields E K=n/3, E S=2n(H_n-1), E Q=(4n/3)(H_n-1)+2n/9 and covariance recurrence v_(n+1)=(n-1)v_n/n-2/9. Telescoping proves v_n=-(n-3)(n+2)/(9(n-1)) for all n≥3; n=2 separate. Exact weighted-shape enumeration through n=12 and independently recursed exact moments through n=300 passed 1232 rational tests. Computations corroborate, not replace, induction.

originality.rationale: A comparison of exact statements in three accessible classical full-text sources, 2026 indexed mathematical records and own accessible claims found no equivalent or dominating mixed cherry–Sackin identity. value.rationale: Cherry count (local sister-pair abundance) and Sackin root-to-leaf depth (global tree imbalance) are standard distinct YHK null-model diagnostics. Their cross-covariance calibrates their joint use; strict negativity throughout all nontrivial sizes and exact -n/9 leading scale give substantive dependence information not inferable from the known marginal moments. The closed finite-n cancellation through cherry-member depth is a structural mechanism rather than an arbitrary finite sample table.
